mapper.select: SELECT t.`id` AS `tag_id`, t.`tag_name`, t.`category`, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `manga_tag_relation` count_relation INNER JOIN `manga` active_manga ON active_manga.`id` = count_relation.`manga_id` AND active_manga.`user_id` = #{userId} AND active_manga.`deleted` = 0 WHERE count_relation.`tag_id` = t.`id` ) AS `tag_count` FROM `manga_tag_relation` r INNER JOIN `manga` owned_manga ON owned_manga.`id` = r.`manga_id` AND owned_manga.`user_id` = #{userId} INNER JOIN `manga_tag` t ON t.`id` = r.`tag_id` AND t.`user_id` = #{userId} WHERE r.`manga_id` = #{mangaId} ORDER BY t.`category`, `tag_count` DESC, t.`tag_name`, t.`id`
